# routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_port (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_port" "port" {
  egress_rate_queue0 = "example"
  egress_rate_queue1 = "example"
  egress_rate_queue2 = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `egress_rate_queue0` (String) Egress traffic limitation in bits per second for queue0. Accepts an integer with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix.
- `egress_rate_queue1` (String) Egress traffic limitation in bits per second for queue1. Accepts an integer with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix.
- `egress_rate_queue2` (String) Egress traffic limitation in bits per second for queue2. Accepts an integer with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix.
- `egress_rate_queue3` (String) Egress traffic limitation in bits per second for queue3. Accepts an integer with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix.
- `egress_rate_queue4` (String) Egress traffic limitation in bits per second for queue4. Accepts an integer with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix.
- `egress_rate_queue5` (String) Egress traffic limitation in bits per second for queue5. Accepts an integer with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix.
- `egress_rate_queue6` (String) Egress traffic limitation in bits per second for queue6. Accepts an integer with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix.
- `egress_rate_queue7` (String) Egress traffic limitation in bits per second for queue7. Accepts an integer with an optional `k`, `M` or `G` suffix.
- `map` (String) The priority-to-profile mapping table used for the ingress packets of this port.
- `name` (String) Port name.
- `pfc` (String) The Priority-based Flow Control profile that controls the ingress priority traffic of this port.
- `profile` (String) The QoS profile assigned by default to the ingress packets of this port.
- `trust_l2` (String) Whether to trust the Layer-2 VLAN header (PCP field) of the ingress packets.
- `trust_l3` (String) Whether to trust the Layer-3 IP header (DSCP field) of the ingress packets.
- `tx_manager` (String) The transmission manager responsible for the packet egress of this port.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean)
- `running` (Boolean)
- `switch` (String) Name of the switch the port belongs to.
